label.description: Short label under the bar (e.g. 'GPT-4', '2024', 'OpenAI'). Truncated with ellipsis at 5+ bars.
label.title: Label

value.description: Numeric value above the bar. Must be positive; values ≤0 are dropped.
value.title: Value

title.description: Chart title displayed at the top (max ~50 chars for clean fit)
title.title: Title

bars.description: 2-7 bars. First 7 rendered; extras silently dropped.
bars.title: Bars

accent_color_hex.description: Bar fill color as 6-char hex without leading # (e.g. '00D4FF' for cyan, 'FF2040' for red)
accent_color_hex.title: Accent Color Hex

background_color_hex.description: Background color as 6-char hex without leading #. Default is slate-950 for high contrast with white text.
background_color_hex.title: Background Color Hex

video.description: Rendered 1080x1920 h264/AAC mp4 with bt709 color metadata and silent stereo audio track.
video.title: Video

bars_rendered.description: Number of bars actually drawn (input capped at 7).
bars_rendered.title: Bars Rendered

duration_seconds.description: Actual output duration in seconds (matches input).
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
